en.heroTitle: Satva Dealer Program — Vermicompost Distributor & Agri Retailer Partnership
en.heroLead: Partner with Satva Organics as a district dealer, agri-input shop, nursery stockist, or orchard-input retailer. We support serious partners with quality product, crop guides, and coordinated supply from Mohali.

sectionsBeforeTable.title: Who Should Apply
paragraphs: Agri-input shops, nursery retailers, orchard-input dealers, and distributors who already serve farmers in horticulture belts. You should have storage space, local farmer relationships, and interest in organic / bio-input categories.
We focus on North India first—HP, J&K, UP, Punjab, Haryana—and expand with partners who can move 50 kg bags consistently.

sectionsBeforeTable.title: What Satva Provides
paragraphs: Consistent product quality, branded 50 kg bags, crop-wise farmer guides, and direct communication for pricing and dispatch. Demo support and sample packs can be discussed for active territories.

table.title: Dealer Partnership Overview
rows: Avoid overlapping active dealers where possible
table.intro: We keep the first application simple—details are refined on call.

items.label: Step 1:
items.text: Share name, phone, city/state, and business type on WhatsApp or our contact form.

items.label: Step 2:
items.text: Short call to understand your shop, territory, and monthly volume range.

items.label: Step 3:
items.text: Trial dispatch and dealer terms for approved partners.
Bulk vermicompost and pan-India wholesale options
Packaging sizes for shelf and backend stock

faqs.question: Do I need a large warehouse?
faqs.answer: You need dry storage for 50 kg bags and basic handling capacity. Exact requirements depend on your territory and monthly volume—we discuss on call.

faqs.question: Is exclusive territory available?
faqs.answer: We try to avoid too many dealers in the same micro-market. Territory focus is discussed during onboarding.

faqs.question: Can nursery shops apply?
faqs.answer: Yes. Nursery stockists and agri retailers are welcome if they serve growers who buy vermicompost regularly.

cta.title: Apply for Dealer Program
cta.description: WhatsApp your city, business type, and districts you cover.

hi.heroTitle: सत्व डीलर प्रोग्राम — वर्मीकम्पोस्ट वितरक साझेदारी
hi.heroLead: जिला डीलर, एग्री इनपुट दुकान, नर्सरी स्टॉकिस्ट या बागान इनपुट रिटेलर के रूप में सत्व के साथ जुड़ें।

sectionsBeforeTable.title: कौन आवेदन करे
paragraphs: एग्री दुकान, नर्सरी रिटेलर और वितरक जो किसानों की सेवा करते हैं। सूखा भंडारण और स्थानीय संबंध जरूरी।
पहले उत्तर भारत—HP, J&K, UP, पंजाब, हरियाणा।

sectionsBeforeTable.title: सत्व क्या देता है
paragraphs: सुसंगत गुणवत्ता, 50 किलो बैग, फसल गाइड और सीधा संपर्क।

hi.faqTitle: डीलर — अक्सर पूछे जाने वाले प्रश्न

faqs.question: बड़ा गोदाम?
faqs.answer: 50 किलो बैग के लिए सूखा भंडारण—कॉल पर चर्चा।

faqs.question: एक्सक्लूसिव क्षेत्र?
faqs.answer: माइक्रो-मार्केट में ओवरलैप कम रखते हैं।
